newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE economy grows by nine pct in 1996 - minister.
newsitem.headline: UAE economy grows by nine pct in 1996 - minister.

text.p: The UAE's economy grew nine percent in 1996 and the non-oil sector boosted its contribution to the country's gross domestic product (GDP), a minister said in remarks published on Sunday.

Al-Khaleej daily quoted Minister of State for Finance and Industrial Affairs Ahmed bin Humaid al-Tayer as saying GDP grew nine percent. It did not specify whether he was referring to nominal or real growth.
Official estimates put inflation at between four and five percent but economists say it runs as high as 12 percent.
Like its Gulf Arab neighbours, the United Arab Emirates wants to diversify its economy to reduce vulnerability to fluctuations in world oil prices.
